testcase.name: Scenario: Change panel title visibility from an inactive tab: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:166:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change panel title visibility from an inactive tab ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon selected ✔ And panel titles are visible ✔ When the user opens the inactive Sketch tab context menu ✔ Then 3D Model remains selected and Show Panel Titles is checked ✔ When the user clears Show Panel Titles ✔ Then the menu closes and the 3D Model panel titles are hidden ✔ And 3D Model remains selected ✔ When the user selects Tools ✔ Then the Tools panel titles are also hidden ✔ When the user opens the Tools tab context menu ✔ Then Show Panel Titles is unchecked and Tools remains selected ✔ When the user selects Show Panel Titles ✔ Then the menu closes and the Tools panel titles are visible ✔ And Tools remains selected ✔ When the user returns to 3D Model ✔ Then the 3D Model panel titles are visible
